# Original pre-browser Apps1.19

Captured from accepted apps61 source before the default protocol3 switch. The profile2 producer, localization, markup, manifest, sealed view sources and original browser/style implementation preserve actual pre-browser graph and reference consumers. Tests build these original producers; they do not reconstruct old output from the new default. The native stylesheet and named legacy browser interpreter serve profile1/2, native/direct and retained references. Remove each archived implementation after those consumers retire.
